---
title: "Introduction to Machine Learning Systems"
subtitle: "Semester plan · Volume I"
---

## Overview {#overview}

This course studies data pipelines, model training, optimization, and deployment on a single machine. Students
need Python, linear algebra, basic calculus, and introductory probability. The supporting textbook is
[MLSysBook Volume I](https://mlsysbook.ai/vol1/).

## Syllabus and schedule {#syllabus}

The adaptable [semester syllabus](https://mlsysbook.ai/instructors/foundations-syllabus.html)
contains the course overview, prerequisites, weekly schedule, and teaching notes.
The weekly plan pairs textbook readings with labs and TinyTorch implementation work. Its milestones and assessment guidance support a semester of building and evaluating the machinery behind a deployed model.

The syllabus remains the source for the teaching sequence. An institutional
offering should specify its own dates, submission deadlines, and local policies.

## Materials {#materials}

| Resource | Use |
|:---|:---|
| [Volume I](https://mlsysbook.ai/vol1/) | The weekly readings. |
| [Lecture slides](https://mlsysbook.ai/slides/vol1.html) | One deck per chapter, with speaker notes and in-class exercises. |
| [Interactive labs](https://mlsysbook.ai/labs/) | Browser-based experiments that pair with the readings. |
| [TinyTorch](https://mlsysbook.ai/tinytorch/) | The framework students build from scratch, one module at a time. |

## For instructors {#for-instructors}

The [Instructor Hub](https://mlsysbook.ai/instructors/) provides
[pedagogy](https://mlsysbook.ai/instructors/pedagogy.html),
[assessment](https://mlsysbook.ai/instructors/assessment.html),
[TA preparation](https://mlsysbook.ai/instructors/ta-guide.html), and
[customization guidance](https://mlsysbook.ai/instructors/customization.html).
This course can also run as the first half of a two-semester sequence with the
[scaling course](../scaling/index.qmd); the
[course map](https://mlsysbook.ai/instructors/course-map.html) shows how they connect.

## Offerings {#offerings}

The [course directory](../index.qmd) lists courses at other
institutions that use MLSysBook. Each institution maintains its own syllabus,
schedule, and enrollment information.
